title: observability: add token-level KV cache metrics, dashboards, and alert tuning
author: Samira Khan
description: Summary: Add token-level KV cache observability (metrics + traces), Grafana dashboard panels, and tuned alert rules to help SRE and runtime teams diagnose cache inefficiencies and token-level cost/latency regressions. Motivation: Recent incidents (SUP-893) showed cache miss storms driving token-level latency and cost spikes. This change provides visibility into KV cache hit/miss rates by model/route, per-token latency distribution, and token-level cost attribution. It also introduces alert tuning (thresholds and rate windows) to reduce noisy alerts while keeping SLO safety margins. What this PR does: - Instrumentation: adds token-level KV cache counters, histograms for per-token latency, and tags (model, route, customer_tier, shard). Exposes metrics via Prometheus exposition in services/observability. - Tracing: adds span annotations for KV cache hit/miss and TTL expiry to the existing request trace path so traces can correlate token-level events with overall request latency. - Dashboards: new Grafana panels focused on token-KV metrics, heatmaps for per-token latency distribution, cost-per-token breakdown, and a per-route summary with top offenders. - Alerts: introduces tuned alert rules (longer windows and aggregated by route/model) to avoid noisy paging while ensuring detection of sustained regressions. - Docs and runbooks: adds runbook snippets and dashboard links in docs/observability/token-kv-metrics.md. Rollout plan: - Feature flagged by env var OBS_TOKEN_KV_METRICS=true. - Will rollout to staging for 48h, then progressive rollout to canary nodes for 24h before enabling cluster-wide. - Alerts initially created in alerting namespace with notify:sre-preview; once validated they will be promoted to notify:oncall. Testing: - Unit tests for histogram bucket boundaries and label cardinality checks. - End-to-end test that verifies metrics are emitted and visible in a test Grafana instance. - Local smoke test scripts included under telemetry/test-scripts. Related: follows work from ENG-1972 (initial token observability spike analysis) and complements recent KV cache optimizations in runtime (see pr-162999). Checklist: - [x] Instrumentation implemented and tested - [x] Dashboards added (dev/stage) - [x] Alert rules added and tuned (preview) - [x] Docs and runbook snippets added - [x] CI green Notes: kept label cardinality low by limiting customer_tier and model labels to known enums; heavy routes are sampled for per-token histograms to avoid high cardinality.
commits_summary: 3 commits: 1) add token_kv metrics and histogram buckets + unit tests; 2) add Grafana dashboard panels and JSON for token-level views; 3) add alert rules, runbook snippets, and docs. Commits were squashed on merge.
